title: Deterministic local queue/worker core
implementedBehavior: Versioned immutable routing envelope separates logical work, source request, ActionIntent digest/idempotency, delivery, scheduling claim, approval, native admission, and MP-04 durable identities.
Deterministic in-memory queue supports enqueue, availability, compare-and-set claim, completion, explicit bounded release, and logical outcome inspection.
Worker loads canonical ActionIntent through a trusted Protocol boundary and recomputes MP-02 integrity before MP-03.
Worker calls accepted MP-04 executeAdmittedAction only after current MP-03 ADMITTED; it never calls an effect adapter directly.
Activity records are bounded explanatory evidence and are not read as authority or execution input.

scenarios: valid MP-03 to MP-04 execution with one synthetic effect
same-delivery replay and completed logical-work replay
competing workers with one active scheduling claimant
forged workId, digest, principal, tenant, resource, target, parameters, and worker claim
tampered activity and stale admission observation ignored

MP-06C: retry budgets, retry storms, dead letters, and full concurrent stress
MP-06D: MP-05 presentation parking and durable decision observation
approval expiry, rejection, revocation, and recovery
repeated waiting deliveries and post-decision fresh MP-03 to MP-04 continuation
